t: This is St Chad's Vicarage, a clergy house in Hackney. It was designed by James Brooks, an influential Gothic Revival architect who made his name with a series of landmark churches built in the East End of London in the 1860s and 1870s. In 1895 the Royal Institute of British Architects awarded him its Royal Gold Medal. That reputation is the reason a modest clergy house like this one is worth a second look.
